text:
The plate looks like scrambled egg whites (or a similar pale egg) plus two strips of bacon.

Egg whites: about 100 g, at roughly 52 kcal per 100 g, so about 52 kcal.
Bacon: two thin strips, about 8 g each when cooked, so about 16 g. At roughly 540 kcal per 100 g, that is about 86 kcal. I'll round to about 85.

Total mass is about 116 g, and total energy is about 52 + 85 = 137 kcal. I'll round to 140.

{"kcal": 140, "mass_g": 115}
